reviews.comment: Once a week there is 2 quizzes, a discussion post where you respond to two peers. The workload is def manageable. There is three exams including the final exam, which aren't proctored. He sent out weekly reminders of what was due. He's honestly the best easy A.

Great class! Highly recommend. I am a business major and taking this class online was great and helped me balance other coursework. Prof. Creel is super passionate and knowledgeable about what he teaches. He is also very communicative and sends reminders. The class mainly consists of online lectures, participation discussions and quizzes! Take!!!

I've never taken an online class before, so I was a little scared, to be honest. However, Prof. Creel made it easy! Once a week, you have to: watch the lectures, do a participation activity, a quiz, a discussion question, and respond to two peers. The exams are open-note and based on the quizzes on Canvas, which are 30% total, which is lovely. :)
